Hi {user},

thanks for reaching out about **{category}**.
Someone from the team will get back to you here as soon as possible.

Use the buttons below to close the ticket or, as a team member, to bring in a subteam.

{roles}

banlog.panel:
🔨 **Ban report**

Pick the reason. You'll be asked to confirm before anything is sent.
No matching reason? Use `/banreason reason:<text>`.
banlog.notice: New entry in the hall of shame. Reason: {reason}
banlog.reasonGone: This reason no longer exists. Please reload the panel.
banlog.expired: This confirmation has expired. Please pick the reason again.
banlog.sendFailed: ⚠️ The report could not be sent. Please check the output channel.
